items.name: Stone Fishing Rod
lines: No perks of its own: the start of the Stone rig (+10% Attraction with 2 pieces, +20% and +10% Experience with 3)

items.name: Crystal Fishing Rod
lines: Fish Finder: Shows what bit, how good it is and how rare, and chimes, the moment a fish bites

items.name: Diamond Fishing Rod
lines: Bonus XP: +1 to 4 experience with each catch, on top of the usual

items.name: Netherite Fishing Rod
lines: Lava Fishing: Lets you fish in lava

items.name: Rod of Resonance
lines: Echo Sense: Shows what's on the hook the moment it bites, with a sculk click

items.name: Rod of the Hero
lines: Mentor: Players fishing within 16 blocks of you get +10% Experience
Bounty: A bonus item with every catch: usually an emerald, or iron, a book, an apple, a stick or a poppy

items.name: Blazing Fishing Rod
lines: Hellfire: Nether fish bite in any lava
Lava Fishing: Lets you fish in lava
Hot Line: 15% chance each fish comes up cooked

items.name: Beeline
lines: Beekeeper: 10% chance of a honeycomb with any fish, and 50% of a honey bottle with Great or better fish

recipe.note: Sometimes drops when you harvest honeycomb from a hive.

items.name: Midas Fishing Rod
lines: Midas Touch: A gold item with every catch: usually a gold ingot, sometimes a golden carrot, golden apple or gold block

items.name: Amethyst Fishing Rod
lines: Moonlit: +8% Quality at night on a full moon (less as the moon wanes, none on a new moon)

items.name: Mangrove Fishing Rod
lines: Slime Trail: 20% chance of a slime ball with any fish

items.name: Cherry Fishing Rod
lines: Blossom: 25% chance of pink petals with any fish

items.name: Conduit Fishing Rod
lines: Saltwater and freshwater fish bite in either

items.name: Clockwork Fishing Rod
lines: Day and night fish bite at any time

items.name: Wayfinder Fishing Rod
lines: Fish from every region can bite in any water
Far Reach: Stronger the farther you fish from world spawn: from 500 blocks out, up to +15% Quality, +30% Fortune and +10% Experience at 5,000 blocks

items.name: Rotten Fishing Rod
lines: Scavenger: 35% chance of a mob drop with each fish (bones, string, gunpowder...)

recipe.note: Rarely dropped by zombies and husks you kill (about 1 in 400; Looting helps).

items.name: Widow Fishing Rod
lines: Night Hunter: Strong after dark, sluggish by day

recipe.note: Rarely dropped by spiders and cave spiders you kill (about 1 in 300; Looting helps).

items.name: Sickle Fishing Rod
lines: Harvest: 25% chance of seeds with each fish
Green Thumb: 35% chance each fish makes nearby crops grow

recipe.note: Very rarely found when you harvest fully grown wheat (about 1 in 1,500).

items.name: Grove Fishing Rod
lines: Forager: 35% chance of tree drops with each fish (saplings, sticks, apples...)

recipe.note: Very rarely found in leaves you break (about 1 in 3,000), or in leaves that fall on their own (about 1 in 40,000).

items.name: Drowned Fishing Rod
lines: Sunken Loot: 35% chance of sunken loot with each fish (kelp, copper, prismarine...)

recipe.note: Rarely dropped by drowned you kill (about 1 in 300; Looting helps).

items.name: Hex Fishing Rod
lines: Hex: 20% chance each fish gives you a helpful potion effect

recipe.note: Rarely dropped by witches you kill (about 1 in 150; Looting helps).
